shortDescription: According to Bloomberg, strategist Ed Yardeni cut his S&P 500 Index year-end forecast for a second time in about two months after a powerful stock selloff pushed the benchmark into a technical correction. He said a bear market is unlikely.

title: Yardeni Trims S&P 500 Year-End Forecast Again, Says Bear Market Is Unlikely
